description: This file manages Bluetooth Mesh settings in Zephyr OS, including setting, scheduling, and storing configuration data, with functions for handling pending settings and committing changes.

methods.name: bt_mesh_settings_set
methods.description: Reads a setting value using a callback and validates its length.

methods.name: mesh_commit
methods.description: Commits mesh settings if conditions are met, including starting mesh after loading settings.

methods.name: bt_mesh_settings_store_schedule
methods.description: Schedules storage of settings based on pending flags and timeout configurations.

methods.name: bt_mesh_settings_store_cancel
methods.description: Cancels scheduled storage of a specific setting flag.

methods.name: store_pending
methods.description: Stores all pending settings that have been flagged for update.

methods.name: bt_mesh_settings_init
methods.description: Initializes the settings subsystem, including starting the work queue.

methods.name: bt_mesh_settings_store_pending
methods.description: Triggers immediate storage of all pending settings.
